vertices.label: Concept
vertices.name: Agent Loop & Query Mechanics

Understands message types and iteration patterns
Can trace execution through a multi-step agent task
Knows how query() differs from synchronous completions

evidence.summary: Knows general think→tool→result flow from daily Claude Code usage; fuzzy on specific SDK message types (SystemMessage, AssistantMessage, ResultMessage, StreamEvent) and streaming config details

vertices.label: Concept
vertices.name: System Prompt Crafting for Agents

vertices.label: Skill
vertices.name: Context Compaction & Token Management

Knows prompt caching benefits and limitations

vertices.label: Skill

gap_analysis.effective_scope_estimate: You already cover ~55% of the impact-weighted graph through existing knowledge. The remaining gaps concentrate in two clusters: (1) observability & testing (almost entirely new), and (2) SDK-specific implementation details for primitives you already understand conceptually. Estimated curriculum: 2 weeks intensive rather than 4+ weeks from scratch.
research_flags: The learner corrected that agent teams and skills work in the SDK, not just Claude Code. The research dossier may have under-represented SDK-native features vs Claude Code features. Recommend re-research with expert sources (Anthropic engineering blog, creator content) before curriculum design.
